cohort: A single patient diagnosed with Junctional Epidermolysis Bullosa with Pyloric Atresia (JEB-PA) and Aplasia Cutis Congenita (ACC).
finding: The application of Integra-Dermal Regeneration Template and split-thickness skin grafting resulted in well-vascularized neodermis and full transplant take, suggesting it as a potential new treatment option for patients with JEB-PA and ACC to prevent severe complications.
